messages.subject: Project Lyra - Subscription & Shareholders' Agreement (first draft)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Rachel, David,

Please find attached our first draft of the Series C Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement. It follows the agreed term sheet - £30m subscription, £15.00 per share, 1.0x non-participating preference senior to Series B, and the governance package in clause 7 and the IRA (which will follow separately).

Warranties and the limitations are at clauses 8-9 and Schedule 4. We've pitched the Founder cap at 2x and a 24-month general survival as a starting position. Grateful for your mark-up in tracked changes.

Best,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
